_help: The whole script of the tutorial. Edit the wording freely; tests measure every line.
WHERE TEXT GOES (and how long it may be)
- 'say' is spoken by the Grimoire in its strip: 2 lines of 46 characters,
or 1 line when the same step also has a 'write'.
- 'write' is a query shown under 'say' in query colours: 44 characters.
- 'dummy' is the Training Dummy's speech bubble: 2 lines of 26 characters.
- 'keys' is the reminder at the bottom of the book: 76 characters.
- a quest 'label' is one checklist line: 42 characters.
- {rows} {cast} {lost} {mp_before} {mp_after} {rune} are filled in by the game.
GHOST (how much of 'example' the page offers as faded text)
- full: the whole query, TAB writes it.   keywords: only SELECT and FROM.
- hint: nothing faded, a hint line instead.   none: nothing.
GOAL (a lesson passes on what the query DID, never on how it was typed)
- look: true        a free look: nothing was cast or used
- from: 'enemies'   the table the query read
- visible: [...]    columns that must be readable on the page (not cut off)
- spells_cast: 1    at least this many of Ada's spells took effect
POINT (what the Grimoire circles while it talks)
- row:0  cell:weakness:0  column:element  header  right_edge  cast_rows
- cut_row  status  mp_bar  foe_hp  tables_button  guide_button  ready_button
REVEAL (parts of the screen that stay hidden until a lesson shows them)
- ada_panel  foe_panel  status  looks  tables_button  guide_button

hints._help: A stuck player climbs one level when EITHER number is reached. Level 1 restates the goal and shows the query, level 2 fades in the next word, level 3 offers to write it together.

opening.say: Before any guardian: practice. This straw dummy cannot hurt you. Nothing here can.

lessons.title: LOOK
lessons.keys: TAB writes the faded text     CTRL+ENTER casts it

intro.say: A query asks a table for its rows. Watch me ask the table called witch.

after.say: One row, one creature: that is you. Each column is one fact about you.

task.say: Your turn. Look at the dummy:

lessons.restate: Ask the table enemies for everything:
lessons.off_goal: A real query! But I asked for the dummy:

success.say: There it is: one row, one dummy. You just wrote your first query.
success.dummy: Take a picture. It lasts longer.

lessons.title: CHOOSE
lessons.keys: TAB finishes a word     CTRL+ENTER casts it

intro.say: My page is narrow: a wide row gets cut at the right edge. So ask for less.

after.say: Two names after SELECT, a comma between them: two columns on the page.

task.say: Now find what the dummy is weak to:

lessons.restate: Two columns from enemies, name and weakness:
lessons.off_goal: Good look! But its weakness is not there:

success.say: Fire. Remember it: a foe's weakness takes double damage.

lessons.title: READ
lessons.keys: CTRL+ENTER casts it     ESC skips the tutorial

intro.say: Two looks, and your MP has not moved. Looking is free. So read before you act.

after.say: Your satchel. I left out the column name on purpose. You will soon see why.

task.say: Read your spells: ask the table spells for element, power and mp_cost.

lessons.hint: columns: element, power, mp_cost   table: spells
lessons.example: SELECT element, power, mp_cost FROM spells
lessons.restate: Three columns from the table spells:
lessons.off_goal: Nice, but I want to see each spell's element:

success.say: The first spell is Fire, and the dummy is weak to Fire. Only 3 MP, too.
success.dummy: I do not like where this is going.

lessons.title: CAST
lessons.keys: CTRL+ENTER casts it     ESC skips the tutorial

intro.say: Now the magic. A row that carries a name does not just show it. Watch.

after.say: You drank an Ether and ate a Herb. A name on my page is a trigger.

task.say: Attack the dummy: ask the table spells for its name column.

lessons.restate: Spell names are triggers. Ask for them:
lessons.off_goal: Nothing hit the dummy. Ask spells for name:

success.say: {cast} spells fired, and Fire hit twice as hard. But read the rest.
success.dummy: Ow. Ow. Ow. Ow. In that order.

success.say: My page holds 4 rows. The other {lost} fell off the bottom and fizzled.
Yet you paid for all {rows}: MP {mp_before} to {mp_after}. That is the Rule of the Page.
Here, I refill your mana. Guardians will not be so kind.

practice.title: PLAY
practice.keys: F5 READY     F4 TABLES     CTRL+ENTER casts     ESC skips

intro.say: Free practice. Nothing can go wrong here. TABLES (F4) lists what you can ask.

task.say: Try these if you like. Press F5 when you feel READY.

quests.label: Put your own element on the page

done.say: Arcane. Neither strong nor weak against anything. Like a spreadsheet.
Empty: it knows no spells. A guardian's book will not be. Read it.
Every query ever cast here, yours included. This world forgets nothing.

all_done.say: All three! You read tables better than most witches. F5 when READY.

ending.say: One thing should bother you: you wanted ONE spell, and you paid for all of them.
There is a rune for that. The next guardian knows it. Watch its book.
All I showed you is in the GUIDE (F3). Open it whenever you are lost.
Something round and green wobbles out of the bushes: the ASTERISK SLIME!

coach._help: One-line reactions. The game adds the lesson's query under them, so the player always sees what to type next.
coach.miscast: No harm done: a miscast is free. Try this:
coach.enter: ENTER makes a new line. CTRL+ENTER casts.
coach.cast_too_early: Oops: those names fired spells! That is next.
coach.ghost_word: Follow the faded word: TAB takes it.
coach.offer: Stuck? Press TAB and I will write it with you.
coach.refill: I refill your mana. In here it is free.
coach.practice_miscast: No harm done. Read the red note and try again.
coach.skip: Skip the tutorial?  ENTER: skip   ESC: stay

dummy._help: The dummy's own lines. One is picked each time (never the same twice in a row).
dummy.name: Training Dummy
looked_at: Yes, that is all of me.
My good side is the left.
Read me like a book. Ha.
hit: Ow. I am a prop, you know.
I felt that in my seams.
idle: Take your time. I am straw.
